episodes.209847: A strong cold front produced snow squalls and wind gusts to near 50 mph as it moved south across southern Lake Michigan during the morning of January 14th.
episodes.210316: A clipper low passed north of Lake Superior bringing a strong cold front south across the lake. Storm force gusts occurred with the frontal passage.
episodes.210324: A clipper low passed north of Lake Superior bringing a strong cold front south through the region including the Bay of Green Bay. Storm force gusts occurred with the frontal passage.
